standard-dialogue.npc: It's nice to meet you here, [player name].

steps.npc: I'm Chuck. I used to exchange logs for certificates, so people could trade them in bulk more conveniently. Certificates were what we used before banks automatically issued banknotes for most tradeable items.
Even today, banknotes are sometimes referred to as 'certs', in memory of the certificates we used before.
I had colleagues who'd exchange other items for certificates - Niles, Miles and Giles were the most famous of us. But those three found new jobs rather than retiring like I did.

options.text: Do you think you might leave the Realm?

steps.player: Do you think you might leave the Realm?

steps.npc: No, I don't think so. The big high-street banks made my work useless, and I don't fancy joining Niles, Miles and Giles on their weird treks.
No, I'll stay here and enjoy my retirement. It's nice of you to ask, though.

standard-dialogue-using-a-noteable-item-.npc: If you want that converted into a banknote, take it to a bank - banks made my work useless, so they can deal with your requests now. I've retired.

standard-dialogue-using-a-bank-note-on-h.npc: If you want your banknotes converted, take them to a bank - banks made my work useless, so they can deal with your requests now. I've retired.

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-that-can.npc: Even in your so-called modern era there's no such thing as a banknote for that. Hah!
